title: UBEM-MCP: Urban building energy modeling data and simulation for AI assistants
description: An open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, Python library and command line that gives AI assistants, scripts and people one tested interface to urban building energy modeling: building data with recorded provenance, archetype or user-supplied EnergyPlus models, background batch runs, district results, retrofit scenarios, comparison with measured energy use and national reference data.
